title: Sales By Customer's Product Type filter now reads Sales Type
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Customer is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Find the filter that used to read "Product Type" and open it.
  2. Read its label with both options selected.
  3. Untick Service Sales.
  4. Untick Part Sales too.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: it is labelled "Sales Type", with two options, "Part Sales" and "Service Sales".
  • Step 2: it reads "Sales Type: All Sales".
  • Step 3: it reads "Sales Type: Part Sales".
  • Step 4: it reads "Sales Type: No sales".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S8-R6, S8-R7, S8-R8, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), pages 4 and 5 (cited by the story), export read 19 Oct 2026, used for on-screen labels; the look itself is checked in the "Design — how it looks" cases. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R6: “On Sales By Customer, the filter labeled "Product Type" today is labeled "Sales Type".”
  • S8-R7: “Its two options read "Part Sales" and "Service Sales".”
  • S8-R8: “With both options selected, the filter reads "Sales Type: All Sales". With one, it reads that option's name, for example "Sales Type: Part Sales". With none, it reads "Sales Type: No sales".”
